extracted.intended_audience: school teachers/selectors of children's reading material and users/redistributors of Project Gutenberg eBooks
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for selecting and adapting classical hero tales for use with school children and the legal/technical requirements for distributing the resulting eBook (Project Gutenberg license requirements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Suitability for young readers
rubrics_metrics.description: Place some of the best of such tales early within the reach of school children and all young readers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Knowledge of these cycles helps young readers enjoy modern literature; the importance of placing adapted tales early for school use cannot be disputed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prefer independent, episode-like selections
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose episodes, complete in themselves, and connected only by a slender thread with the main narrative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Independent shorter stories lend themselves more readily to the demands of the schoolroom; the volume is intentionally made up mostly of such episodes so each tale can be used separately in reading-classes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adaptation for intelligibility and interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not repeat the story in its exact original form; recast and rearrange, using your own words and adding touches of color or fanciful ideas as the narrative permits or as the audience may demand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Without proper adaptation such stories are usually neither interesting nor intelligible to children. Nevertheless, while recasting, 'the essential features of each tale—those which give it value in its original form—remain unchanged.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Aim to preserve intrinsic/essential features
rubrics_metrics.description: While adapting language and details for children, retain the essential features that give each tale its value in the original form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adaptation may include word changes and added color, but must not diminish the core virtues/lessons and structural elements that make the tale valuable.
